>If you do a strike that costs a blood and your foe uses one that ends

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Paul Schaaf <sch...@u.washington.edu> writes:

>If you do a strike that costs a blood and your foe uses one that ends
>combat, do you pay the blood for the strike or not?

Yes, you pay for the card that gives you a strike.
